ndbd03e43e5.headline: New call for agricultural insurance for 2020 approved, endowed with eight million euros
ndbd03e43e5.summary: The Junta of Extremadura approved a decree to promote contracting Combined Agricultural Insurance with an €8 million endowment for 2020.
ndbd03e43e5.why: Agricultural insurance support can stabilize farm incomes and reduce risks in the regional agricultural sector in Spain.
